name: Tao of the Ten Thousand Hands

effects.l1: Second hand: a non-attack, non-move second action (draw, aim, use a skill).
effects.l2: Second breath: the second action may be a move, enhanced by Six Directions or Light Step.
effects.l3: Second strike: the second action may be an unarmed attack.
effects.l4: Second blade: the second action may be a strike or block with an off-hand weapon or shield.

system.description: Chain a second action straight after the first, before anyone reacts. The second action can't carry other Tao effects unless stated.
